notes.title: SeesGame 1.5
notes.content:
- All levels have been adjusted and updated (Normal mode)
- Background sprites have been updated (Normal, Free, Race, Debug Mode )
- Bonus Level difficulty has been adjusted (Blue heart has been added which resets the player's speed)
- Performance improvement.

- New achievements have been added
- Classic mode has been adjusted
